items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.implication: Davante Adams featured; deeper Rams WRs elevated in targets/snaps.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Adams and secondary WRs like Mumpfield/Fields.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL, expected to miss a few weeks. Zach Ertz signed to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: Sprained MCL confirmed via tests; MRI/results point to multi-week absence.
items.implication: Ertz elevated; Eagles TE targets redistribute short-term.
items.opportunity: Ertz snaps/routes; possible other TE/WR bumps in red zone.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib). RJ Harvey inactive; grab Jonah Coleman if available.
items.why: Practiced, optimism from reports; wore protection if needed. Harvey hamstring not expected.
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; Harvey out elevates Coleman.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes/targets intact; Coleman handcuff/backup upside.

items.text: Pregame summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism, flak jacket) and Puka Nacua (hip). Not expected: RJ Harvey (hamstring). Expected: Chris Olave (hamstring), Joe Burrow (back), others. OUT: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: McConkey/Puka GTD resolved later; Flowers/Pittman out create target bumps; Olave/Burrow clear.
items.opportunity: Bernard/Coleman etc for out players; full roles for expected.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; attempting rehab not surgery. Out several weeks, likely IR; possible midseason return.
items.why: Heel aggravation; rehab preferred over surgery.
items.implication: Colts WR targets to Downs/Pierce backups; multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs or others elevated targets.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow; consulting experts. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left (non-throwing) elbow again; no fracture on initial X-ray but further tests.
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders offense limited, WRs/TEs downgraded short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; monitor return timeline (weeks possible).

items.text: Bears coach Ben Johnson: expectation Caleb Williams 'will likely miss some time' with hamstring. Same left hamstring as prior college injury.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring pull; carted off; prior history.
items.implication: Bears offense without Williams; Bagent or backup elevated, pass-catchers docked.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; monitor ROS timeline.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks. Chargers placing both on IR.
items.implication: Gadsden clear TE opportunity with Herbert.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell clear secondary.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes for Irving; start with confidence.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs playmakers while Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson more involved even if Stevenson leads; dual-back committee.

items.text: Sunday injuries watch: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), Aaron Jones (knee), JK Dobbins (hamstring), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), David Njoku (knee)/Charlie Kolar (forearm), others.
items.why: In-game exits and postgame reports across multiple teams.
items.implication: Broad monitoring for Week 3 statuses; beneficiaries per player.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley to undergo MRI after stinger; hope it is minor. Played through it after returning with neck roll.
items.why: Stinger on first play; returned but limited; MRI cautious.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3; Bigsby/Shipley temporary beneficiaries if sits.
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation if multi-week; otherwise full role.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Pivot Parkinson if flex open; else WR Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
items.implication: Stream deeper Rams options in flex/WR.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE. Target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead.
items.implication: Must-start WR; high floor/ceiling on volume.
